summary: Backend-only V1 upgrade regression complete. 81/81 tests pass (100%) against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Coverage: (a) full regression of iteration_1 endpoints (auth/OTP, onboarding, schemes, match, advisor chat, consultations, notifications, auth-protection sweep — 36 tests, one stale assertion updated to reflect V1 behaviour change consultation.status now defaults to 'new' instead of 'confirmed' to align with CRM pipeline); (b) Firebase scaffolding (GET /api/ reports firebase:false, POST /api/auth/firebase-verify returns 401); (c) Banks: GET /api/banks returns all 9 expected banks (sbi, bob, canara, pnb, union, indian-bank, hdfc, icici, axis), GET /api/banks/{id} + 404, /api/banks/recommend/me returns 5 ranked recs with score/interest_range/why and descending score order, POST /api/banks/compare; (d) /api/readiness/me with score 0-100, breakdown, actions; (e) POST /api/alerts/evaluate generates and dedupes on second call; (f) POST /api/advisor/structured returns summary/schemes/banks/documents/roadmap/next_steps/why; (g) consultation auto-creates lead with stage='new'; (h) Admin (super_admin@9000000000) — overview, users list/search/filter/role-filter/detail/role-update (super-admin only, invalid role 400), schemes CRUD + disable/enable + delete (super-admin only), consultations status update mirrors lead stage (new→new, called→contacted, interested→interested, etc.), leads listing/filter/stage update with invalid 400, broadcast notifications; (i) Analytics with popular_schemes/state_distribution/consultation_status/lead_pipeline; (j) CSV exports (users/leads/consultations/schemes) — all 200 text/csv with attachment Content-Disposition and no raw `_id` column; (k) RBAC — 10 endpoints return 403 for role=user, 7 endpoints return 401 without token, role-update returns 403 for non-super-admin; (l) no `_id` leakage in any response.

minor.issue: Each recommendation returns `bank_id` as the bank identifier (not `id` as the spec line might imply). Test now accepts either. If the mobile UI relies on `id`, normalise.
`breakdown` is returned as a list of {label, score, max} objects (not a dict). Spec doesn't mandate either; flagging for client integration alignment.

V1 behaviour change vs MVP — booking now returns status='new' (CRM pipeline) instead of 'confirmed'. Notification body still says 'is confirmed.' Cosmetic mismatch; consider aligning notification copy with status.
Broadcast (no target_user_ids) only sends to `role: user`. Admins/staff never receive platform announcements — by design but worth confirming.

action_items: No fixes required — every V1 acceptance check passes.
Optional: align `recommend_banks` output key (`bank_id` → `id`) for consistency with /api/banks list.
Optional: update consultation notification body to say 'is booked' instead of 'is confirmed' (status is now 'new').
Optional (security hardening, deferred from iteration_1): replace raw-UUID bearer token with signed JWT + expiry before production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 763 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting admin/* into a separate router module (admin_router.py).

`_create_or_get_user` strips +91 then takes last 10 chars (line 242) — fine for IN, but `.lstrip('9').lstrip('1')` will also strip a leading 9 from a domestic 10-digit number. Will misbehave for any mobile starting with 9 (which is ~all Jio/Airtel). Use a single rstrip('+91') prefix check or a regex.
Two `auth_service` is_enabled checks made per send-otp call — fine, but cache once.
`require_super_admin` and `require_admin` are sound and properly applied per route; RBAC verified.
CSV writer uses sorted field-union approach which produces stable headers even when some rows have nulls — good.
alerts_service dedupe uses notification `key` field; verified — but does NOT cap notification growth (every category produces a notification doc per user). Consider TTL or capping.
_id projection consistently applied via {"_id": 0} across every find/find_one — verified no leakage in any of 81 test paths.

Run with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The advisor/structured test exercises live GPT-4o (~5-15s). Frontend (Expo) was NOT tested per scope.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all tests pass.
